pages.title: Quiet Cultivation
pages.text: Cultivators meditate in safe places and accumulate real progress. Combat, injury, conversation, following, control effects, or unsafe ground interrupt training. Their method must support their realm and their progress must meet the breakthrough requirement.

pages.title: Qi Refining to Foundation
pages.text: A Late Qi Refining cultivator needs a Breakthrough Pill, enough progress, and sufficient Qi and health before attempting Foundation Establishment. Giving the pill does not grant an instant breakthrough; the cultivator must first be safe.

pages.title: Combat Priorities
pages.text: Cultivators keep their valid opponent when beasts arrive. Afterward, nearby hostile beasts take priority over another player or NPC. Cultivators have saved, weighted method proficiency; higher mastery is rarer. Golden Core or stronger cultivators need 500 active-method proficiency for a domain. They keep that art during combat and protect bystanders.

pages.title: Combat Priorities
pages.text: Release lasts up to ten seconds, then recovers for ten seconds. Cultivators may grow stronger between meetings.

pages.title: Wandering Spell Merchants
pages.text: Spell Merchants wander the Overworld in violet robes. Each carries twelve distinct spell scrolls, limited by the merchant's realm; stronger merchants favor advanced spells. Open Trade through their interaction menu and pay the listed spirit-stone price. Sold scrolls stay sold until the next in-game day.

pages.title: Wandering Spell Merchants
pages.text: Buying a scroll does not learn it: use its normal learning process and meet its requirements.
